name: AI, NLP, LLMs & Deep Learning Architecture
stats: Transformer from scratch · Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with RRF · 23-detector NLP pipeline
content: Advaith works across deep learning, NLP and retrieval. Key work: a decoder-only transformer written from plain PyTorch tensors (causal self-attention, LayerNorm), matching PyTorch's reference within 1e-5; Hugging Face Transformers and sentence-transformers; spaCy pipelines; NLI-based claim verification; and hybrid retrieval that fuses BM25 and dense embeddings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (0.900 MRR vs 0.867 and 0.733 for either alone).
